_comment: Shared by tests/js/*.test.js and model/tests/. Generated by hand-run script from the cases in test_server_core.py (see git history of the migration). `envFile` is the text of a .env file; `environ` is the process environment, which wins over the file. `expect` keys are dotted paths into the normalised view {google:{mode,configured,projectId,location,clientEmail,error,hasApiKey}, models, segmentation:{engine,edgeRefine,edgeMethod,analysisMaxSide}, sam:{enabled,backend,modelId,maxSide,preload,hasServerKey,remoteUrl}, warnings:[...]}. A value may be {"contains": text} (substring of a string) or, for warnings, {"anyContains": text}. Only the keys named in a case are checked. The private key in these cases is a placeholder, not a real key.

parse.name: the forms people paste
parse.text:
# c
A=1
export B = two words  # note
C="x\ny"
D='{"k":"v\n"}'
E=
F=a#b
M='a
b'
H=1
H=2

parse.name: CRLF line ends and a byte-order mark
bad lines are skipped, never raised
an unterminated quote takes the rest of its line
a double-quoted value expands escapes, a single-quoted one does not
a trailing comment after a quoted value

settings.name: service account in single quotes
service account as base64
key pasted into GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT still works, with a warning
an explicit project id wins over the key's
settings.envFile:
GCP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON='{"type": "service_account", "project_id": "my-project-123", "private_key_id": "testkeyid0123456789", "private_key": "-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----
TESTKEYNOTREAL
-----END PRIVATE KEY-----
", "client_email": "swatchroom@my-project-123.iam.gserviceaccount.com", "client_id": "1234567890", "token_uri": "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token"}'
GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT=other-project-9

settings.name: a project id that is not an id is ignored with a warning
settings.envFile:
GCP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON='{"type": "service_account", "project_id": "my-project-123", "private_key_id": "testkeyid0123456789", "private_key": "-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----
TESTKEYNOTREAL
-----END PRIVATE KEY-----
", "client_email": "swatchroom@my-project-123.iam.gserviceaccount.com", "client_id": "1234567890", "token_uri": "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token"}'
GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT=NOT A PROJECT

settings.name: garbage JSON gives a readable error, not a crash
JSON that is not a service account is rejected
a key without a private key is rejected
token_uri must point at googleapis.com
a look-alike host is not googleapis.com
a googleapis.com sub-domain with a port is fine
a custom token_uri is allowed when custom endpoints are switched on
settings.envFile:
GCP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON='{"type": "service_account", "project_id": "my-project-123", "private_key_id": "testkeyid0123456789", "private_key": "-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----
TESTKEYNOTREAL
-----END PRIVATE KEY-----
", "client_email": "swatchroom@my-project-123.iam.gserviceaccount.com", "client_id": "1234567890", "token_uri": "http://127.0.0.1:9/token"}'
TERUCON_ALLOW_CUSTOM_GOOGLE_ENDPOINTS=1

settings.name: a Gemini API key alone means api-key mode
GOOGLE_API_KEY is accepted as an alias
GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI=false forces the API key
settings.envFile:
GCP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON='{"type": "service_account", "project_id": "my-project-123", "private_key_id": "testkeyid0123456789", "private_key": "-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----\nTESTKEYNOTREAL\n-----END PRIVATE KEY-----\n", "client_email": "swatchroom@my-project-123.iam.gserviceaccount.com", "client_id": "1234567890", "token_uri": "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token"}'
GEMINI_API_KEY=abc123
GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI=false

settings.name: GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI=false without a key is an error

settings.name: model overrides are validated
segmentation defaults
segmentation settings are read and clamped
analysis size has a floor
unknown engine and method fall back with warnings
SAM is off by default
SAM on with a server key
a SAM_REMOTE_URL turns backend auto into remote
SAM_BACKEND=remote without a URL switches SAM off with a warning
unknown SAM backend falls back to auto
the real environment wins over the file
